summary: Release-candidate hardening after A1-C2 supervisor acceptance (LC-SUP-002, PASS_WITH_CONDITIONS). Closed two of the three narrow, non-blocking documentation-sync gaps LC-SUP-002 explicitly asked a future task to pick up: c2.json's coreEngineRequirements[3] (multi-capability delayed retrieval) is now annotated RESOLVED by LC-INT-001, matching the note pattern b2.json/c1.json already carry for their parallel F8 entries, since learnerModel.js's recordDelayedRetrievalEvidence is genuinely implemented and live-wired from EpisodeShell.jsx; c1.md now quotes the master's personalization invariant sentence verbatim for parity with a1/a2/b1 (documentation-only, no behavioral change, C1 has no runtime episodes). Deliberately left untouched, per LC-SUP-002's own framing: B1's older suggestionEn-presence evidence-tagging convention (b1Arc*.js), which LC-SUP-002 explicitly called a future B1 content-alignment task, not a hardening blocker (B1 stays unavailable, zero learner-facing benefit, real regression risk touching six files' evaluator-adjacent code); and C2's one deliberately-deferred sustain_coherence_across_topic_shifts prerequisite, which LC-AUD-001 itself asked to leave to explicit human judgment. Also ran a hardening audit of the write-scope surface: confirmed provider_policy.py still fails closed with no key, no accidental level opened (A1-C2 available:false, Pre-A1 frozen 17 episodes per check:pre-a1-freeze), no hardcoded secrets/leftover console.log or debugger statements/TODO markers in either app, no eval/exec/pickle/shell=True in the backend, CORS is an explicit allow-list not a wildcard. Found and fixed one real gap: ChatRequest.message (app/routes/chat.py) had no max_length, unlike every other free-text field in this codebase's request models (EvaluateRequest.learner_response is max_length=500) -- added max_length=4000, verified against test fixtures (longest existing message literal: 22 chars). Documented all of this in docs/release/rc-001-hardening-report.md. This task's write scope explicitly excludes docs/research/**, so the evidence corpus was read-only re-verified (still READY, 120/127 unique primary studies) and never rewritten, per check-foundry-automation.mjs's own enforced invariant for this task. No level's available flag was touched; A1's own separate completion gate (LC-PED-002 plus the dedicated availability-flip task) remains untouched and still required.
